cases.question: Tell me about Pdfroo
cases.judge_reason: All claims match the expected facts and are consistent with the known public description of Pdfroo.
cases.answer:
**Pdfroo** is Ayush's fully client-side PDF editor — open a PDF in your browser, annotate, sign, reorder/merge pages, find & replace, compress, and download a real flattened PDF. **Nothing uploads**; all parsing, rendering, and writing happen locally via **pdf.js + pdf-lib**, and it works offline once loaded.

**Highlights**
- Runs on phones, tablets, desktops (mouse, pen, touch)
- No build step, no backend, no install — just open `index.html` or the live demo
- Clean landing page with a kangaroo mascot, light/dark theme, drag-and-drop, sample PDF
- Thumbnail sidebar (desktop), slide-in drawer (tablet), bottom sheet (phone)
- Drag-to-reorder (SortableJS), rotate, duplicate, delete, insert blank pages, merge PDFs
- After first successful download: a friendly kangaroo toast — *"Your PDF never left your device. Go enjoy a coffee ☕"*

**Tech:** JavaScript, CSS, HTML (pdf.js, pdf-lib, SortableJS)  
**Repo:** [ayush4u/pdfroo](https://github.com/ayush4u/pdfroo) (MIT)  
**Live:** [ayush4u.github.io/pdfroo](https://ayush4u.github.io/pdfroo/)
